# EffectiveEntitlements

What a tenant is entitled to right now: its plan's terms, with any terms agreed for this tenant applied on top. Everything that limits or prices work reads this. Null on a limit means unlimited.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tenantId` | `uuid` | The tenant these are for. |
| `tier` | [`SkuTier`](sku-tier.md) | The plan. |
| `cadence` | [`BillingCadence`](billing-cadence.md) | Whether the plan is paid monthly or annually. |
| `currency` | `string` | The currency the tenant is billed in. |
| `status` | [`ContractStatus`](contract-status.md) | `Frozen` after a failed renewal payment, until it's paid or the time to pay runs out. |
| `skuCatalogueVersion` | `integer` | The version of the plan definitions these terms come from. |
| `priceBookVersion` | `integer` | The version of the price list these prices come from. |
| `billingAnchorUtc` | `datetime` | The instant the tenant's billing months are counted from. |
| `allowances` | [`MeterAllowances`](meter-allowances.md) | What the plan includes each billing month, per meter. |
| `storageCapGb` | `number \| null` | How much the tenant may store at once, in GB. |
| `lanes` | [`EffectiveLane`](effective-lane.md)`[]` | How many runs of each kind may run at once. |
| `maxPartitions` | `integer \| null` | The most knowledge bases (temporary ones included) the tenant may hold. |
| `maxFileSystems` | `integer \| null` | The most file systems the tenant may hold. |
| `maxCredentials` | `integer \| null` | The most model credentials the tenant may hold. |
| `maxCredentialStacks` | `integer \| null` | The most credential stacks the tenant may hold. |
| `retentionDefaultHours` | `integer` | How long a finished run is kept, in hours, unless it's retained. Never more than `EffectiveEntitlements.RetentionMaxHours`. |
| `retentionMaxHours` | `integer \| null` | The longest a run can be kept, in hours. |
| `overageDiscountBasisPoints` | `integer` | The discount on work beyond the allowances, in hundredths of a percent (1500 is 15%). |
| `priority` | [`QueuePriorityClass`](queue-priority-class.md) | Where the tenant's work waits relative to others' when the platform is busy. |
| `premiumExecution` | `boolean` | The plan includes sandboxes (capsules) and code pipelines. |
| `canTopUp` | `boolean` | The plan can buy credit (top-ups and automatic top-ups). |
| `planPricePerMonth` | `number` | The subscription price per month on the contract's cadence. |
| `planPriceAnnualPerMonth` | `number` | The subscription price per month, billed annually. |
| `planPriceMonthly` | `number` | The subscription price per month, billed monthly. |
| `rates` | [`MeterRates`](meter-rates.md) | What work beyond the allowances costs, per meter. |
| `webFetchUnits` | [`WebFetchUnitTable`](web-fetch-unit-table.md) | How many fetch units a page costs, by how it's fetched. |
| `lanePrices` | [`LaneAddOnPrice`](lane-add-on-price.md)`[]` | The price of one more lane of each type the tenant can buy on its tier. |
